description: Score individual and entity KYC risk across six FATF dimensions: customer type, product/service type, delivery channel, geographic risk, transaction behaviour, Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/110-customer-risk-rating.html for interactive use. Renders the interactive AINumbers tool as a widget; inputs are applied via the AIN Bridge and the tool runs client-side (zero PII, zero network). Output schema: call describe_tool("customer_risk_rating").

inputs.description: Map of tool input element IDs to values (see manifest input_schema). Applied via AIN Bridge prefill.
